clue_ghost_ticket.title: Platform Zero Transit Pass
clue_ghost_ticket.description: A magnetic metro card with no expiry date, issued for Carriage 104.
clue_ghost_ticket.lore: The ticket was already in your pocket when you woke up on the train.
